uutiset.t: From conceding seven to Hull heroics - how Tzolakis recovered to defy Brighton
uutiset.s: Nine days after playing for Greece in a nightmare 7-0 loss, keeper Konstantinos Tzolakis plays a pivotal role in Hull's Premier League win against Brighton.

uutiset.t: Pochettino on 'painful' defeat in first game as Man Utd boss
uutiset.s: Manchester United's new head coach Mauricio Pochettino says his side must transform "anger" from their thumping at the hands of Liverpool into "energy" to improve under his reign.

uutiset.t: Yoro sees red as Ngumoha shines - Liverpool v Man Utd player ratings
uutiset.s: How Liverpool and Manchester United's players rated following their Premier League match.

uutiset.t: 'Russell is living rent free in Verstappen's head!'
uutiset.s: BBC Sport's Harry Benjamin, Rebecca Clancy and Abbi Pulling discuss the clash between George Russell and Max Verstappen as their rivalry heats up both on and off the track.

uutiset.t: The red card that changed Liverpool-Man Utd: correct call?
uutiset.s: Leny Yoro's red card after eight minutes changed Liverpool v Manchester United - did officials make the correct call?

uutiset.t: Spurs deny Man City top spot with statement win
uutiset.s: Despite taking an early lead through Khadija Shaw, Manchester City suffer a second consecutive defeat as Spurs earn an impressive victory and deny them the chance to return to the top of the table.

uutiset.t: Man Utd score dramatic late winner to extend record run
uutiset.s: Simi Awujo's last-gasp winner caps a remarkable Manchester United comeback at Birmingham, securing a dramatic victory and stretching the club's record unbeaten run to 14 matches.

uutiset.s: Holders Celtic as well as Rangers, Glasgow City, Hearts, Montrose, Aberdeen and Falkirk progress with big wins in the Women's Scottish Cup.

uutiset.t: Arsenal frustrations grow as winless home run continues
uutiset.s: Arsenal remain without a home win in the WSL as they play out a goalless draw with West Ham, increasing the pressure on Renee Slegers.

uutiset.t: Jakirovic full of praise for Tzolakis performance
uutiset.s: Hull head coach Sergej Jakirovic is pleased with his side's "precise" counter-attacking to earn a victory over Brighton, and describes goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis' performance as "unbelievable."

uutiset.t: 'Rolls-Royce' Iqbal's 'dream' journey from Old Trafford to Tannadice
uutiset.s: Zidane Iqbal is starting to live up to his famous name and wowing Scottish Premiership fans after his move to Dundee United.

uutiset.t: Spurs 'a match for anyone' as European hopes boosted
uutiset.s: With the Women's Super League big four firmly established, and London City Lionesses spending their way into European contention, Champions League dreams could have seemed more fanciful than ever for Tottenham Hotspur. But they are firmly in the mix.

uutiset.t: PSG's Doue to have surgery on ruptured ACL
uutiset.s: Paris St-Germain forward Desire Doue will have surgery later this month after rupturing the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee.

uutiset.t: Liu Wenwei suspended amid match-fixing investigation
uutiset.s: Chinese snooker player Liu Wenwei is suspended from "attending or competing on the World Snooker Tour with immediate effect" amid an investigation into match-fixing.

uutiset.t: Did beaten Wales still show they have come a long way?
uutiset.s: Wales believe they are on the up despite failing to back up their win against New Zealand when beaten by Australia in the Nations Championship.
